requirements.quote: I/We certify that we/our Collaborator/Assignee are/is not from such a country or, if from such a country, have/has been registered with the Competent Authority and we will not sub-contract any work to a contractor from such countries unless such contractor is registered with the Competent Authority.
requirements.text: Bidder must certify compliance with restrictions on procurement from countries sharing a land border with India.

requirements.quote: We here by certify that we fulfill all requirements in this regard and are eligible to be considered.
requirements.text: Bidder must certify eligibility based on compliance with procurement restrictions.

requirements.quote: We further confirm that evidence of valid registration by the Competent Authority for us/our Collaborator/JV Partner / Consortium member/Assignee, as applicable, is enclosed as Annexure…
